description: Find offers on the circle's marketplace (read API GET /listings): what an account offers and what it wants. Use it to discover who sells a service; for an order that already exists use x207_order_status. Returns {items, nextCursor}; pass nextCursor as `cursor` for the next page. No match gives an empty list, not an error. Needs the read API (X207_BACKEND_URL) and fails with a clear message without it.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page; leave out for the first page.

offerClass.description: Settlement class of the offered asset (A to D, X for other); keep only listings of this class.

offerType.description: Asset type the lister offers, e.g. service:summary; exact match.

status.description: Listing state to match; open when left out, all for every state.

wantType.description: Asset type the lister wants in return, same form as offerType.

name: x207_search_listings
title: Search marketplace listings
